item.title: [LU-20413] sanity test_49a: mysterious VM reboot during test
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Andreas Dilger <adilger@dilger.ca>

This issue relates to the following test suite run:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/603722c3-d078-47ce-991b-79b74f66789f

test_49a failed with the following error while running a test:

Timeout occurred after 130 minutes, last suite running was sanity

There was nothing shown on the OSS console that would indicate a problem (stack trace, oops, LASSERT()), and this subtest has not failed in the past few months (as much as my patience for waiting on Maloo search results would allow).

[ 2223.541922] Lustre: DEBUG MARKER: == sanity test 49a: Change max_pages_per_rpc won't break osc extent ========================================================== 19:23:42 (1781810622)

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: jgwoun, colmstea, not much to go on here, so this is mostly an FYI and a ticket to track if there are similar failures in other sessions.

All of the instances documented in this ticket occurred on onyx-159 which was over-subscribed and running out of disk space allocated to the VMs.

 

IO error device='virtio-disk0' node-name='libvirt-2-format' reason='No space left on device'

 

I have reduced the number of VMs on onyx-159 and will look into why the monitoring did not alert us.

Re-open if new occurrences are found.
